name: selection-banner
title: Selection banner
description: The line under a table header that offers to select every row across all pages once the whole page is selected.
docs: Mount it when every row of the page is selected. It reads 'All 25 orders on this page are selected' with 'Select all 312 orders'; once allSelected is true it reads 'All 312 orders are selected' with 'Clear selection'. Keeping the 'everything matching the query' flag is yours, because only you know what all 312 means. It is one button that changes its words, so focus stays on it. Clear selection is the exception: it removes the banner and the button that had the focus, so in onClear move focus to the header checkbox of the table first (the demo does).
